parsed.name: Elveflow MUX 1/12 微流控分配阀
parsed.description: 这是一台用于微流控与液路切换的 1 进 12 出分配阀/多路选择器，可将单一路流体依次切换到多个通道或样品路径。它常用于微流控实验、自动化注液、试剂分配、样品切换和多通道流路管理。
parsed.description_en: This is a 1-to-12 microfluidic distributor/selector valve used to route a single fluid line to multiple channels or sample paths. It is commonly used in microfluidics experiments, automated reagent delivery, sample switching, and multi-line fluid path management.
